description: Send a file to a chat. Pass exactly one of blob_id with filename, for a file this task produced, or file_id, to send again a file received in a telegram.event. kind decides how Telegram shows it. Returns chat_id, message_ids and kind.

chat_id.description: Chat to act in: chat.id from a telegram.event, or a public @username. Omit it only for the configured home chat or the single allowed user.

topic_id.description: Forum topic: topic_id from the telegram.event.

reply_to_message_id.description: Answer this message: the event's message_id. In groups, always reply to the message you answer.

blob_id.description: Content hash of an artifact payload to upload.

filename.description: Plain file name for an uploaded blob, such as report.pdf.

file_id.description: file_id of a file from a telegram.event.

kind.description: How Telegram presents the file; document by default.

caption.description: Caption under the file, Markdown unless format says otherwise; it must fit one caption.

format.description: How the text is written: markdown (default), plain text, or Telegram HTML.

buttons.description: Inline keyboard as rows of buttons. Each button has text and exactly one of data (at most 64 bytes, returned as a button event when pressed) or url (an http, https or tg link).
